notes.title: Exciting news!

Their fresh endeavour has just been announced at The MIX, along with a line-up of 2 other amazing games. Check out the entire showreel here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/GYgZxk9CugU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]One thing that we wanted to highlight is that we will retain creative control over the game, so you don’t have to worry about any unexpected changes - onesies and other quirky costumes are staying! notes.title: From the hero’s journal #2: “Let’s talk about… the dungeons”
notes.notes:
[p][i]📝 Journal Entry #2:[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Hey there,[/p][p]So, yeah - down in the dungeons, pretty much [i]everything[/i] is going to try to kill you. I’m not trying to sound dramatic, but seriously… be ready for it. ☠️
[/p][p]Yesterday, I fought an army of skeletons, demons, and… an ogre. Yes, an ogre. He was possessed, okay? Don’t give me that look - he wanted me gone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311808/ac416561922cc6c4d4949b5d4de17ecf0d07546d.gif"][/img][/p][p]The day before? A pack of deranged mages chased me through cramped tunnels and lava lakes. By the way… how do they have so much stamina? Seriously. 🏃‍♂️💨
[/p][p][b]In Void Dungeon, fights don’t play nice.[/b] They’re fast, brutal, and full of surprises. Expect wave after wave of enemies coming from every direction. At first, it’s just basic skeletons - individually they’re not too scary, but when a whole swarm comes charging at you… things get hot real fast. 🔥 And then come the mini-bosses, ready to drain you dry - literally and figuratively.[/p][p][/p][p]Better have your gear upgraded, potions stocked, and favorite skills mapped to the right keys - because later? There won’t be time to fix your mistakes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311808/a2fd269b5d509f05cb4bf522051a8c06e8cc3cda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here’s what to expect when you descend:[/p][list][*][p][b]Enemies with serious anger issues:[/b] Undead that call for backup, mages who teleport like they’ve had too much coffee, and bosses that probably wrote the word [i]“unfair”[/i] in their diaries. 📖[/p][/*][*][p][b]A combat system that actually feels good:[/b] Unleash devastating skills, pull off clutch dodges… or die trying. ☠️[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rising chaos:[/b] The deeper you go, the worse it gets. More enemies. Smarter enemies. Less room for error. 😬[/p][/*][/list][p]Look, I’d give you some advice, but if you’re reading this, you’re already doomed. Just… if you hear the music change, it’s probably too late.[/p][p]See you in the depths, hero. Bring snacks. And maybe a backup life plan.[/p][p]- [i]Xaya the Explosive, elven illusionist[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p]Follow the game on:

notes.title: From the hero’s journal: “Who even am I today?”
notes.notes:
[p][i]📝Journal entry #1[/i]:
I woke up with a beard today. Not a metaphorical, “deep and wise” kind of beard—an actual, glorious, dwarven necromancer beard. Yesterday, I was an elf in an astronaut suit. The day before? Let’s just say the cat onesie didn’t help much when I got set on fire by an infernal demon. But I [i]looked[/i] adorable while burning, so there’s that.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Void Dungeon[/i], you can be [i]whoever the void[/i] you want. Seriously.
We’ve got more customization options than a noble in Kingdom of Chads has gold rings. Want to play as a goblin monk in a banana costume? Go ahead. Dream of being a noble knight who wears a bathrobe and slaps monsters with a frying pan? It’s your destiny now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311808/f068065361251d5333d99af6eb427970e39239b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]When we say customization, we mean: [/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🪄 Races and classes[/b] that shape not just how you look, but how you fight, cast, or explode things. [/p][/*][*][p][b]⚔️ Skills and gear[/b] you can mix and match until you've built your perfect storm—or an unhinged mess that somehow [i]works[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎩 Outfits that range from badass to bonkers[/b], including cat onesies, space suits, and probably a cursed clown wig. Why? Because why [i]not[/i].
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311808/ea620f84eb3bca442fceb46e84c08feba34164a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if anyone says you look ridiculous?
Hit them with a necro-siren’s death beam while wearing a pirate hat. Style [i]is[/i] a weapon, friend.[/p][p][/p][p][b]In Void Dungeon, customization isn’t a feature. It’s a [i]statement[/i]. 💬
[/b]A statement that you’re done with grey-hooded clones. That your hero can rock a pink cape, summon meteor storms, and solo dungeons like a legend—or team up with a co-op crew that looks like a cursed circus from the ninth circle of chaos.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the dungeons. Just… let me know what you’re going for today, okay?
If you show up tomorrow looking like a flying pickle with a greataxe, I want to be emotionally ready.[/b][/p][p][b]With bearded love,
[/b] — [i]Xaya the Explosive, elven illusionist in an astronaut suit, self-declared Void fashion icon from Glamouris - Kingdom of Elves[/i][/p][p]

notes.notes:
⚡ Brace yourself, adventurers!

Void Dungeon is crashing into PAX East at booth 15078. We’re bringing the chaos, the cursed loot, and more monsters than you can swing a sword at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311808/c110b3256588cc4ee97e4f8c23d233efd005f13e.png[/img]

🕹️ Get ready to explore a pixel art world where every corner hides danger, every dungeon is a deathtrap, and every drop could be your last. 💀 Choose your class – Knight, Archer, or Mage – and see how long you can last against the relentless waves of enemies and the lure of rare, cursed gear.

[previewyoutube=DtlAwvuse6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Not making it to Boston? No worries. We’ll be back with war stories, epic loot, and maybe a few singed eyebrows. But if you’re heading to PAX East, don’t forget to swing by booth 15078. You’re gonna need all the help you can get.

🖤 Until then – stay stealthy, stay alive, and remember… the Void is waiting. 🌌

notes.title: Void Dungeon is coming! Step into the void…
notes.notes:
[b]Adventurers![/b]

We’re thrilled to finally pull back the curtain on our upcoming project: Void Dungeon. As a duo of passionate developers who live for crafting unique worlds and exhilarating gameplay experiences, this project has been a total passion ride for us. We can’t wait to share the first details with you!

We wanted to challenge ourselves creatively and try something bold - a game that mixes fast-paced action with tons of character customization, all with a pinch of co-op multiplayer fun. That’s how Void Dungeon came to life, bringing intense hack-and-slash gameplay, a quirky sense of humor, and the perfect setup to team up with friends and tackle relentless challenges together.

[b]So, what can you expect from Void Dungeon? [/b]

At its core, this is a 2D Action RPG that challenges you to face increasing threats in dungeons brimming with secrets, traps, and powerful foes. Whether you’re delving into the dungeon solo or fighting alongside up to four friends, you’ll face relentless enemies, each demanding quick reflexes and smart tactics. 

[previewyoutube=DtlAwvuse6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Between battles, you’ll have the chance to refine your character’s abilities, experiment with powerful builds, and - of course - deck yourself out in some wonderful costumes. 

Let’s be honest - who doesn’t want to look fabulous while battling existential doom? ;)

Our goal for Void Dungeon is to deliver more than just flashy combat. We wanted to create a game that rewards creativity and teamwork, while giving players room to express their unique playstyle. Whether you're dodging deadly attacks, pulling off devastating combos, or just competing in leaderboards, we hope that our upcoming games feels like an adventure worth diving into.

[b]The MIX
[/b]
We’re also incredibly proud to share that Void Dungeon was announced at The MIX Fall Showcase. It's an honor to stand alongside so many incredible games, and if you haven’t checked out our trailer yet, it’s now live.

Take a peek and let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=-QYkj8CcPSg;full][/previewyoutube]

We still have a lot of work to do before the void is ready to consume you, but this is just the beginning of what we hope will be a journey we can take together. Every comment, wishlist, and bit of feedback means the world to us, and we can’t wait to share more updates in the coming months.

So, consider adding Void Dungeon to your wishlist if it sparks your interest, and keep an eye out for more sneak peeks, devlogs, and news along the way. Until then, thanks for being part of this adventure!
